item.description: [Album Reviews] One of Ty Segall‘s most unsung qualities is his versatility. item.title: Agalloch’s Ashes Against the Grain is a cinematic metal spectacle
item.description: [Hall of Fame] In 2002, Portland’s Agalloch released The Mantle, a metal album all about how tired they were of making metal. Well, kinda—the album’s lyrics depicted a cyclical journey through the wilderness, inspired by the forest highways in and around Portland. Musically, however, the influx of non-metal influences, specifically post-rock and neofolk, came as a conscious rejection…
